newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London lower, market awaits direction.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London lower, market awaits direction.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London eased on Wednesday, with HSBC Holdings the only feature in cautious and directionless trade, dealers said.
HSBC fell HK$1.70 to HK$222.30, dragged lower by a weak UK bank sector in London.
Dealers said investors in London sat on the sidelines as the nervous mood in Kong Kong continued ahead of possible government curbs on property prices after the handover to China on July 1.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index closed down 38.03 points at 14,165.86, after the Hang Seng index dropped 103.26 points to finish at 14,203.89 in Hong Kong.
